purpose.zh: 练单腿站立时髋关节的旋转控制
purpose.en: Train rotational hip control while standing on one leg.

text.zh: 骨盆和上身一起，绕支撑髋慢慢打开
text.en: Turn your pelvis and trunk together slowly around the standing hip

text.zh: 单腿站稳，膝盖微屈，手轻扶椅子
text.en: Stand on one leg, knee soft, hand lightly on the chair.

text.zh: 小幅度打开再回正，不扭腰
text.en: Open a little, then return, without twisting at the waist.

commonErrors.en: Twisting the waist instead of turning at the hip.
Letting the standing knee cave in.

cautions.zh: 扶稳无轮的椅子，疼痛或站不稳时就停止
cautions.en: Hold a stable chair without wheels, and stop if it hurts or you feel unsteady.
